The news, weird weather, even small things, like a power flicker at the showroom, feel like signs that everything is winding down.

At the same time, I’ve had stretches lately where I’m running on almost no sleep and still feel wired, like my body is buzzing. I’ll stay up half the night pacing, planning big ideas for the dealership, thinking I can completely transform the market around here. My thoughts race and jump around, and I talk a lot faster, especially when I’m trying to explain how all these “signs” fit together. D004-D010_h001.question_a:

Not like “things are bad” – I mean I’m sure the world is basically winding down, like everything is slowly collapsing and none of this is going to be here much longer. It’s not just a feeling; it’s like a fact in my head. When I’m with customers at the dealership I can still talk, negotiate, close deals – I’m good at that – but in the back of my mind I’m thinking, “Why are we even selling cars when everything’s about to fall apart?”

There were a couple of weeks here and there where I barely slept, felt on top of the world, talking a mile a minute, buying stuff for the showroom we didn’t really need, feeling super confident, even a little reckless with money. There have been a few weeks here and there where I felt unusually energized and upbeat—staying up late planning new business ideas, talking more, feeling like I could do everything at once.
